choices.name: Steam-Gun (12", A2, Blast(3), Assault), Hand Weapon (A2)

Keywords.Sturdy: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
Keywords.Fearless: When failing a morale test, roll one die. On a 4+ it is passed instead.
Keywords.Hero: Models with this rule may be joined to units, and have various special rules.
Keywords.Slow: This model moves -1" on Advance and -2" on Rush/Charge actions.
Keywords.Tough(X): This model must take X wounds before being removed as a casualty.
Keywords.Enhanced Sturdy Aura: This model and its unit get Enhanced Sturdy.
Keywords.Swift Aura: This model and its unit get Swift.
Keywords.Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless.
Keywords.Spell Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Spell Resistance.
Keywords.Fortified: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
Keywords.Scourge: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee.
Keywords.Parry(X): The model counts as having +X to its Defense characteristic when it is attacked in melee.

Army Spells.Rune of Spite (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).
Army Spells.Rune of Breaking (1): Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].
Army Spells.Rune of Protection (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Enhanced Sturdy once (next time the effect would apply).
Army Spells.Rune of Smiting (2): Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with Blast(3).
Army Spells.Rune of Battle (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Rapid Charge once (next time the effect would apply).
Army Spells.Rune of Cleaving (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Scourge.
